name: Gradient Quantization via Polyhedron Tesselation
aliases: Gradient Quantization via Polyhedron Tesselation — Icosahedron-Dodecahedron Gradient Quantization
definition: A method to quantize gradient direction space by tesselating a unit sphere into triangles and using vertices as quantized gradient directions, aiming for even distribution.
summary: Gradient Quantization via Polyhedron Tesselation evenly distributes gradient directions for volume rendering by tessellating a sphere with icosahedron-dodecahedron triangles, avoiding the distortion and clustering artifacts of octahedron-based methods.
